sentences: In 2021, seven people who had just left OpenAI started a new AI lab.
Five years later, that lab filed to go public.
In the first half of 2026, its revenue hit sixteen point three billion dollars.
A year earlier, it was one point two billion.
And in its own filing, it warns that its AI could pose catastrophic risks to humanity.
This is the story of Anthropic.
